cases.title: Requests keep who and when only as the thread states them

inputs.thread:
From: Laura Grant
To: Omar Haddad
Subject: Vendor contract renewal

Omar, the Medline contract expires on 31 October. Can you send me the usage figures by 10 October so we can negotiate?

From: Omar Haddad
To: Laura Grant

Will do. We used 1,240 units this year. I'll also ask Sara to get two competing quotes.

From: Sara Ali
To: Omar Haddad, Laura Grant

I can get the quotes by 17 October. Do we want a one-year or a two-year term?

From: Laura Grant

Decision: we will not auto-renew; we'll compare quotes first. The term question is still open.
